behaviors.behavior: B5 reads phaseTaskId (schema field) instead of id, so a completed phase is correctly matched to its task
B5 still flags a phase_completed event with no corresponding phaseTaskId task
C1 Screens-table parser locates file/linked-FR columns by header name and tolerates an inserted column (the reported regression: 6-column manifest)
C1 header matcher prefers 'Linked FRs' over an earlier, unrelated ambiguous column (e.g. 'FR Status')
C1 'Linked FRs' matcher does not fire on 'Unlinked FRs' (word-boundary correctness)
C1 header matchers are whole-word (do not fire on 'Frame'/other substrings)
A backend-only FR listed under '## Non-UI FRs' with a cited ADR is exempted from the screen-mapping requirement
An FR not listed as Non-UI still fails coverage when it has no screen mapping (exemption does not weaken the gate generally)
A Non-UI FR entry with no ADR reference is ignored, not exempted (closed-vocabulary waiver requires citation)
A stale/misspelled Non-UI FR entry (matches no declared FR) is surfaced even when an unrelated orphan already fails the check
An unparseable/empty Screens table is distinguished in the coverage detail message from a genuine per-FR orphan, even when every declared FR is otherwise exempt

surface_verification.justification: Backend-only compliance-tool bug fix (B5 phase-task field-name mismatch; C1 column-count-brittle Screens-table regex). No UI, no API route, no store mutation, no SSE/WS handler, nothing consumed by a frontend. Verified entirely by pytest unit/regression tests plus 4 rounds of internal+external LLM review against real schema-shaped fixtures.
